name: Son Goku
version: Dragon Ball Super manga · Ultra Instinct
note: Ultra Instinct improves reactions, but its sustained use is taxing. Use manga Super feats and exclude Heroes.

name: Superman
note: Solar-powered flight, physical strength, and heat vision are staples. Kryptonite and red sunlight are deliberate conditions rather than baseline gear.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
version: Fourth War · Six Paths Sage Mode
note: Shadow clones support misdirection and mass attacks. Kurama and Six Paths abilities belong to this listed form.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
note: Getsuga techniques give ranged options beyond the sword. The manga shows limited operating time for true Bankai.

name: Roronoa Zoro
note: Three-sword style and Haki make a high-output swordsman. His ability to keep fighting through injury is stamina rather than regeneration.

name: Erza Scarlet
note: Requip offers different armor and weapons midfight. This profile uses her own late-series kit.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
note: Position switching, genjutsu and Susanoo give varied tools. Cross-universe genjutsu effectiveness remains an assumption.

name: Hiei
note: The Dragon of the Darkness Flame gives powerful area attacks, alongside fast sword work.

name: Shigeo Kageyama
note: Psychic barriers and telekinesis matter more than his physical build. Uncontrolled peaks are difficult to sustain.

name: Tatsumaki
note: Large-scale psychic control and barriers can dominate terrain. Reserve and injury still limit extended output.

name: Aang
note: The original series finale demonstrates all four elements and energybending. Water access and room to maneuver affect options.

name: Edward Elric
note: Clap transmutation and automail provide fast improvisation. A Philosopher’s Stone or outside sacrifices are excluded.

name: Jotaro Kujo
note: Star Platinum's speed and brief time stop are distinct from Jotaro's physical endurance. Cross-world Stand visibility is uncertain.

name: Kenshiro
note: Hokuto Shinken pressure points work exceptionally well against compatible bodies. Applicability to unfamiliar species is uncertain.

name: Kirby
version: Mainline Nintendo games · normal starting kit
note: Inhale and copy abilities create matchup-specific options. Temporary gear is limited to the conditions under which Kirby acquires it.

name: Majin Buu
note: Regeneration can outlast many threats. Complete destruction remains a relevant defeat condition.

name: Ryu
note: Experienced martial artist with Hadoken. Evil Ryu and crossover-only feats are outside this version.

name: Jin Kazama
note: Devil powers add lasers and flight to a strong close-range toolkit. The selectable Devil form is used consistently.

name: Sephiroth
note: Masamune and magic are central. Combat animation scale and Jenova-related effects are interpreted conservatively.

name: Vergil
note: Yamato, summoned swords and Devil Trigger provide varied pressure. Spatial cuts are a mechanic, with cross-world outcomes uncertain.

name: Dante
note: Devil Trigger and a wide weapon kit let him adapt at close and medium range. Ratings use the DMC5 form.

name: Bayonetta
note: Witch Time and summons change tempo. Dodges and summon availability depend on the situation.

name: Satoru Gojo
note: Infinity, Unlimited Void and reverse cursed technique carry distinct mechanics. Defeating Infinity requires a credible interaction.

name: Makima
version: Part 1 · contracts active, no new allies
note: Control and contract-based survival matter greatly. Both are conditional and depend on how the opponent's attack is defined.

name: Frieza
note: Golden form has extreme range and power. The baseline excludes later manga forms.

name: Megatron
note: Armor and fusion cannon anchor his profile. The original cartoon form excludes a composite arsenal.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
note: Heightened smell and breathing techniques inform combat. Demon King transformation is outside this profile.

name: Jonathan Joestar
note: Hamon is particularly effective against vampires. Water can conduct Hamon in the original series.

name: Dio Brando
note: The World's time stop and vampire healing are substantial. Direct sunlight remains a source-specific weakness.

name: Alucard
note: Stored souls and regeneration enable extreme recovery, with different conditions when releasing his restraints.

name: Saitama
version: Manga · Monster Association arc, no time reversal
note: Serious attacks and exceptionally high physical durability are observed. A guaranteed one-hit victory is outside the model.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
note: Gear Five expands flexibility and terrain effects. Seawater immersion can severely impede Devil Fruit users.

name: Vegeta
note: Ultra Ego rewards aggression, while accumulated damage still matters. Use the manga form consistently.

name: Pikachu
note: This is Ash's partner at the end of Journeys. Trainer assistance and game-only moves are excluded.

name: Charizard
note: Flight and fire attacks define the kit. Mega Evolution or a trainer's item are separate conditions.

name: Mewtwo
note: Psychic offense and recovery are available in this game-based profile. Mega forms are separate.

name: Link
version: Breath of the Wild · Master Sword and regular gear
note: Archery, shield use, runes and standard equipment give Link a varied toolkit. External assistance is excluded.

name: Samus Aran
version: Metroid Dread · late-game regular suit kit
note: Suit mobility and layered weapon systems support fights at range. One-off ending transformations are excluded.

name: Scorpion
note: Chain spear, hellfire and teleportation define Hanzo's attack options. The newer timeline's Scorpion is separate.

name: Batman
version: Bruce Wayne · standard gear, zero prep
note: Prepared countermeasures and special armor are excluded. Cover favors stealth and ordinary gadgets.

name: Aquaman
note: Swimming and aquatic abilities become more relevant near water. No armies, outside allies or summons are assumed.

name: Wonder Woman
note: Enhanced physical ability and extensive combat training combine with bracers and lasso. Complicated crossover interactions are uncertain.

name: The Flash
note: The Speed Force anchors movement and reaction estimates. Time-travel rewrites and exceptional crossovers are excluded.

name: Heracles
note: Physical strength and the labors are the comparison baseline. Divine apotheosis is outside this version.

name: Achilles
note: Uses the Iliad warrior and armor, excluding later invulnerability traditions.

name: Odysseus
note: Expert deception and archery shape this profile. Divine assistance is outside the one-on-one scenario.

name: Yugi Muto
version: Duel Monsters · Yugi Muto, no physical summon rule
note: Duel strategy is strong, but card mechanics are distinct from physical attacks. Atem and unrestricted divine summons need separate profiles.

name: Magikarp
note: Low-end combat reference for this roster. A weak attack kit does not turn it into a canonical zero in every setting.
